non_negotiable_rules.snapshot_immutability: Counts, classifications, source identity strings, and hashes from the four inputs are evidence snapshots. This queue may add review decisions but may not silently rewrite them.
non_negotiable_rules.no_retrospective_refetch: No network request, endpoint probe, S3 read, or new download may be used to recreate or strengthen historical proof for a 2026-07-22 served object. A later remote response is a new observation, not evidence of the historical bytes or lineage.
non_negotiable_rules.forward_only_evidence: Any future acquisition must be separately authorized, timestamped as new, retain its own source bytes and hash, and must not promote a historical cohort unless it independently satisfies the v2 proof contract for the object then proposed for service.
non_negotiable_rules.no_inference: A generic municipal URL, homepage, S3 locator, pipeline label, inferred URL, or slug-only document match is not source identity and cannot advance a queue item.
non_negotiable_rules.assignment_is_independent: A provenance-state transition does not create, remove, or recompute a lot-zone assignment. The retained 2,276,056 recorded assignments remain a separate fact.
non_negotiable_rules.no_served_status_promotion: Historical-verified and legacy-traceable are local evidence classes, not exact v2 eligibility. No cohort may emit geometry-verified until the exact v2 proof gate passes.
non_negotiable_rules.single_writer: Only the designated queue steward may alter a cohort's state; every transition requires an appended decision record with reviewer, date, and cited local evidence.

states.meaning: Cohort is registered against immutable input hashes; no claim beyond the input classification is made.
states.entry_gate: All four snapshot hashes and cohort arithmetic match this queue.
states.exit_gate: Evidence reviewer records the cited local chain or the explicit absence of admissible lineage.

states.meaning: Only local retained evidence has been reviewed and classified without endpoint or object-store access.
states.entry_gate: Every reviewed collection has a source-report pointer; exact identity strings remain byte-for-byte preserved; exclusions were applied.
states.exit_gate: The class-specific acceptance gate passes, or the cohort is routed to blocked-no-admissible-lineage.

states.meaning: A candidate identity needs an accountable human decision about its link to the served logical collection.
states.entry_gate: The candidate has a cited local artifact or endpoint identity but lacks a proven collection link.
states.exit_gate: Human linkage owner either supplies admissible local linkage evidence, or records that no linkage is available.

states.meaning: No admissible local lineage supports advancement. The cohort remains explicitly quarantined; it is not retried by refetch.
states.entry_gate: Reviewer documents the rejected evidence categories and records the unresolved owner/dependency.
states.exit_gate: Only newly supplied, separately preserved local records can return an item to local-evidence-reviewed.

states.meaning: Local review is complete enough to request a distinct future validation scope; no validation or retrieval is performed by this lane.
states.entry_gate: Class-specific local gate passes, a proof authority is named, and the current API label remains non-verified.
states.exit_gate: A separately authorized forward-only validation plan is accepted outside recovery-r2.

states.meaning: External successor state only: exact collection and feature proof for a newly proposed served object has passed the v2 contract.
states.entry_gate: Separate authorization, immutable new-source capture, exact source/object linkage, feature-level proof completeness, and proof-contract-owner approval.
states.exit_gate: API canary gate passes with no assignment or geometry regression.

states.meaning: External successor state only: additive provenance fields have passed contract and regression checks for a bounded canary.
states.entry_gate: v2-proof-validated, API schema approved, response labels verified, and rollback artifact prepared.
states.exit_gate: Release owner approves progressive rollout metrics.

states.meaning: External successor state only: the additive API label is generally available after approved rollout.
states.entry_gate: Canary error, schema, and assignment-preservation gates pass for the agreed observation window.

forbidden_transitions: blocked-no-admissible-lineage -> ready-for-forward-validation-authorization without new admissible local evidence
any-state -> source proof strengthened by retrospective refetch

actions: Reconcile each retained exact-byte/artifact chain to its served logical collection using only the cited local paths and hashes.

The six artifact hashes and 4,629-feature subtotal reconcile to the source report.
Reviewer records that this is historical linkage only and not exact v2 proof.
fail_or_hold_when: Any chain lacks a local linking record or its artifact hash no longer matches the snapshot.
A current endpoint response is offered as substitute evidence.

api_baseline.rule: The public state remains quarantine; no positive provenance claim is exposed.

lot_baseline.constraint: The input preserves lot impact only by recoverable/quarantine zone status. Per-cohort lot counts for 6, 509, 21, 191, 32, and 112 are intentionally not derived.

operational_success: Every cohort has one owner, next state, acceptance gate, and dependency.
All transitions retain an evidence citation and an explicit decision record.
Unauthorized S3 reads/writes, network calls, deployments, and assignment recomputations: 0.
API responses never emit geometry-verified before v2-proof-validated.

api_rollout_mapping.status: proposed; no API or served-object change is authorized by this queue
api_rollout_mapping.compatibility_rule: Add fields only. Do not repurpose zone_geometry_status, which denotes geometric quality (clean/suspect/fragmented/dispersed), not source provenance.

zone_feature.rule: proof_state is no-v2-proof for every cohort in this queue at creation.

lot_feature.rule: Preserve the lot-status precedence and existing assignment_method; provenance rollouts must not recompute zone_code, assignment_method, or zone_assignment_status.

cohort_to_response_mapping.lot_scope: Only the aggregate 1,164,678 assigned lots joined to recoverable zone collections is known; no per-cohort split is emitted.
Only the aggregate 1,111,378 assigned lots joined to quarantined zone collections is known; no per-cohort split is emitted.
1,153,807 lots remain unaffected by this geometry-provenance queue; 57,924 are in 30 lot collections with no matching logical zone collection.

rollout_waves.gate: API contract owner signs that geometry_provenance is additive and distinct from geometry quality.

rollout_waves.gate: Every canary label matches its queue cohort; proof_state remains no-v2-proof; existing response fields are byte-for-byte semantically unchanged.

rollout_waves.name: lot status exposure
rollout_waves.change: Expose or document zoning_proof_status as the four-value derived lot status without a per-cohort impact split.
rollout_waves.gate: Lot partition remains 0 / 1164678 / 1111378 / 1153807; assignment_method and zone_code distributions do not change.

rollout_waves.name: verified promotion canary
rollout_waves.change: For a separately authorized successor item only, emit proof_state v2-validated and geometry-verified only after the v2-proof-validated state.
rollout_waves.gate: Exact v2 proof, served-object linkage, API regression suite, release approval, and a reversible rollout plan all pass.

api_rollout_mapping.rollback: Remove the additive geometry_provenance field or revert it to the prior non-verified label. Never roll back by altering zone geometry, lot assignments, source snapshots, or historical evidence records.
